title: Classify vendor-specific codes above the standard ranges
description: Several upstreams in front of us emit non-standard codes such as 600 and 999, which `classify` was reporting as `Unknown` and callers were treating as unclassifiable. The author's stated intent was to widen the client-error arm into a guard so that any code at or above 400 lands in a defined class, with a test covering the 600 case.
